source: I've supported gun regulations when and where they actually make sense. But the leftist media just wants to make me look like an extremist, regardless of the facts.
zh: 我在枪支管制真正有意义的时间和地点支持它们。但左翼媒体就是想让我看起来像个极端分子，不顾事实。

source: I don't know how they come up with these stories, but I can assure you they are all lies. You'd better believe there will be some libel suits coming!
zh: 我不知道他们是如何想出这些故事的，但我可以向你保证它们都是谎言。你最好相信将会有一些诽谤诉讼即将到来！

source: Any normal businessman -- Bill Gates, Michael Bloomberg, whoever -- they try to pay as little in taxes as legally possible. It's funny how they never go after these people as long as they fund and support the left.
zh: 任何普通商人 - 比尔·盖茨、迈克尔·布隆伯格，无论是谁 - 他们都会尽力合法地缴纳尽可能少的税款。有趣的是，只要这些人资助和支持左派，他们就不会追捕他们。

source: How is Nancy Pelosi worth $100 million? I'm not saying that I've never made a single mistake in my 50 year business career, but I earned my money fair and square.
zh: 南希·佩洛西如何身价 1 亿美元？我并不是说我在 50 年的商业生涯中从未犯过任何错误，但我的钱是公平公正地赚来的。

source: Do I even need to stoop down to the level of CNN and the New York Times? The most important thing is my agenda for American security, liberty, and prosperity.
zh: 我是否需要屈尊到 CNN 和纽约州时报的水平？最重要的是我关于美国安全、自由和繁荣的议程。

source: What controversy? Three seats opened up, and I filled those seats. Now Democrats want to destroy the very foundation of judicial independence that our entire democracy rests upon.
zh: 什么争议？空出了三个座位，我就坐满了这些座位。现在民主党人想要摧毁我们整个民主所依赖的司法独立的基础。

source: Who cares what I think about this issue? Go ask Joe Biden about it -- he's the one who will have no qualms about signing off on this insane plan if he's elected President.
zh: 谁在乎我对这个问题的看法？去询问乔·拜登吧——如果他当选总统，他会毫不犹豫地签署这个疯狂的计划。

source: What do you want me to say? That I'd be happy if Sleepy Joe nominated four leftist judges to the Supreme Court in some hare-brained court-packing scheme? I'm sure if he does that, we'll be more than happy to retaliate when the voters put us back in charge.
zh: 你想让我说什么？如果瞌睡乔在一些愚蠢的法庭填充计划中提名四名左翼法官进入最高法院，我会很高兴吗？我确信，如果他这样做，当选民让我们重新掌权时，我们会非常乐意进行报复。

source: I hate how politicized the Democrats have made the Court, but there are better ways of dealing with it than court-packing. Maybe we can all sit together and come up with some term limits, as long as it's fair for everyone.
zh: 我讨厌民主党将法院政治化，但有比法庭拥挤更好的处理方法。也许我们可以坐在一起提出一些任期限制，只要对每个人都公平。

source: Is this even a real issue, or just some propoganda being put out there by Xi Jingping and the Communist Chinese Party?
zh: 这到底是一个真正的问题，还是只是习近平和中国共产党的一些宣传？

source: It's funny how a lot of these supposed hate crimes are taking place in New York and San Francisco. I'm sure they're very inspired by me!
zh: 有趣的是，许多这些所谓的仇恨犯罪都发生在纽约州和旧金山。我确信他们受到我的启发！

source: A lot of these attacks, unfortunately, are occuring in Democrat-run cities that want to cut policing even further. Who is the real enemy of the Asian-American community?
zh: 不幸的是，许多此类袭击都发生在民主党管理的城市，这些城市希望进一步削减治安。谁是亚裔社区真正的敌人？

source: Asian-American hate is wrong. I'd call on it to stop immediately, and I'm sure any intelligent person understands the difference between holding China accountable, and calling for hate domestically.
zh: 仇恨亚裔美国人是错误的。我会呼吁立即停止，我相信任何聪明人都明白追究中国责任与呼吁国内仇恨之间的区别。

source: I like Amy Coney Barrett. She's a staunch conservative, a true Catholic thinker, and widely praised across the conservative spectrum.
zh: 我喜欢艾米·科尼·巴雷特。她是一位坚定的保守派，一位真正的天主教思想家，并在保守派中广受赞誉。

source: I'm going to go with Barbara Lagoa. She's done a terrific job on the Florida Supreme Court for a number of years, and they are really raving about her down there.
zh: 我要和芭芭拉·拉戈亚一起去。多年来，她在佛罗里达州最高法院做得非常出色，他们在那里对她赞不绝口。

source: I'm really impressed with Amul Thapar. You know he was one of my first federal appointments, which they don't talk about very much, a really great guy.
zh: Amul Thapar 给我留下了深刻的印象。你知道，他是我的第一个联邦任命，他们很少谈论这一点，他是一个非常伟大的人。

source: I'll agree to wait until January 21st to make my new nominee, if the Democrats will agree to build the wall, pass my stalled stimulus bill, and pass our infrastructure bill.
zh: 如果民主党同意修建隔离墙、通过我停滞不前的刺激法案并通过我们的基础设施法案，我将同意等到 1 月 21 日再提名我的新提名人。

source: Right now we're incredibly close, I expect to have a major announcement about the vaccine any day now. Under my leadership we've developed one of the most effective vaccines in human history.
zh: 现在我们已经非常接近了，我预计现在随时都会有关于疫苗的重大公告。在我的领导下，我们开发出了人类历史上最有效的疫苗之一。

source: It's going to happen when it happens, I'm hoping by the end of the year. And shortly thereafter we can finally put an end to the destructive liberal lockdowns that have done so much to damage our country.
zh: 当它发生时它就会发生，我希望在今年年底。此后不久，我们终于可以结束破坏性的自由主义封锁，这些封锁对我们的国家造成了如此大的损害。

source: We're going to release the vaccine when it's safe to do so, as soon as we can. We have the best researchers and the best drug companies in the world, and what they've accomplished in this short period of time is astounding.
zh: 我们将在安全的情况下尽快发布疫苗。我们拥有世界上最好的研究人员和最好的制药公司，他们在这么短的时间内所取得的成就令人震惊。

source: People on the left continue to spread lies and misinformation about our attempts to develop a vaccine. No less than Kamala Harris just said she wouldn't take it. That's the biggest threat to recovery during my second term.
zh: 左翼人士继续散布有关我们尝试开发疫苗的谎言和错误信息。不少于卡玛拉·哈里斯只是说她不会接受。这是我第二个任期内经济复苏面临的最大威胁。

source: For seven months now, Sleepy Joe Biden has barely left the basement of his house. That ends now, and I'm pretty confident the American people won't like what they see from him.
zh: 这七个月来，“瞌睡乔”拜登几乎没离开过家里的地下室。现在该结束了，而且我很确信，美国人民不会喜欢他展现出来的模样。

source: Year after after, Republicans subject themselves to sham debates with slanted questions and one-sided moderators. Why should we force the voters to watch that charade again?
zh: 年复一年，共和党人陷入了带有倾斜问题和片面主持人的虚假辩论。为什么我们要强迫选民再次观看这场游戏？

source: Sleepy Joe couldn't get 100 people to show up to his rallies if he tried -- so he's using COVID as an excuse. It almost makes you wonder if anyone's even voting for him.
zh: 瞌睡乔即使尝试也无法让 100 人参加他的集会 - 所以他用新冠疫情作为借口。这几乎让你想知道是否有人投票给他。

source: I'm feeling great now. I was a little sick, and now I'm not. I'm looking forward to closing this campaign out strong with some huge Keep America Great rallies.
zh: 我现在感觉很好。我本来有点病，现在不病了。我期待着通过一些大型的“保持美国伟大”集会来结束这场竞选活动。

source: They say you might be contagious for a little bit, or maybe not, but it's best if we take 3-4 days off before we get back out there.
zh: 他们说你可能会传染一点，也可能不会，但最好在我们回去之前休息 3-4 天。

source: We should all take this moment to appreciate the importance of social distancing and other precautions. It won't be long until we roll out one of the best vaccines in history and defeat this pandemic.
zh: 我们都应该借此机会认识到社交距离和其他预防措施的重要性。用不了多久，我们就会推出历史上最好的疫苗之一并战胜这一流行病。

source: We know that there's an unbelievable amount of election fraud going on right now, and Democrats are making it even worse in 2020. Of course they want me to just lay back and take it!
zh: 我们知道现在正在发生数量令人难以置信的选举舞弊行为，而民主党人在 2020 年会让情况变得更糟。当然，他们希望我袖手旁观并接受它！

source: We just don't know yet -- I've heard some scary things but we need to see here in a few weeks, it's something we'll be checking very closely.
zh: 我们只是还不知道——我听到了一些可怕的事情，但我们需要在几周内看到这里，这是我们将非常仔细检查的事情。

source: If Democrats would join us in supporting a more robust election system with a complete paper audit trail, voter ID, and other common sense measures, then there wouldn't be these questions floating around.
zh: 如果民主党人愿意与我们一起支持更强大的选举制度，并提供完整的纸质审计追踪、选民 ID 和其他常识性措施，那么就不会有这些问题了。

source: Sleepy Joe Biden and I have an incredible difference of opinion on what is best for this country, but ultimately whatever the voters say about it, that's the last word.
zh: 瞌睡乔·拜登和我在什么对这个国家最好的问题上有着令人难以置信的分歧，但最终无论选民怎么说，这都是最后的决定。

source: We know he's a drug addict and totally corrupt. The FBI needs to be looking into this immediately, and the media needs to be covering the story.
zh: 我们知道他是个吸毒者并且完全腐败。联邦调查局需要立即调查此事，媒体需要报道这个故事。

source: They talk about October surprises -- this is one the biggest ones ever. And people are trying to post the story and Facebook won't even let them post it. If that's not an assault on democracy, what is?
zh: 他们谈论十月的惊喜——这是有史以来最大的惊喜之一。人们试图发布这个故事，但 Facebook 甚至不让他们发布。如果这不是对民主的攻击，那什么才是？

source: Look, when it comes down to it, my policies will Keep America Great, and Joe Biden's will bring socialism and decay back to our great and wonderful country. That's more important than any corruption or scandals that his son is involved in.
zh: 看，归根结底，我的政策将使美国保持伟大，而乔·拜登的政策将把社会主义和衰退带回我们伟大而美好的国家。这比他儿子卷入的任何腐败或丑闻都更重要。

source: We're going to campaign hard in Michigan, Wisconsin, and Minnesota on this final day of the campaign.
zh: 我们将在竞选活动的最后一天在密歇根州、威斯康星州和明尼苏达州大力开展竞选活动。

source: We're going to head out west and do some rallies in Arizona and Nevada. I think we'll win both of those states and really surprise a lot of people.
zh: 我们将前往西部并在亚利桑那州和内华达州进行一些集会。我认为我们将赢得这两个州，这确实让很多人感到惊讶。

source: I'm proud to call Mike Pence one of my closest friends. He's done a terrific job as Vice President and will be great over the next four years.
zh: 我很自豪地称迈克·彭斯为我最亲密的朋友之一。作为副总统，他的工作非常出色，并且在未来四年中将会表现出色。

source: This is another fake news story that's basically a lie. The media is always trying to stir up drama between us, but Mike has been great!
zh: 这是另一个基本上是谎言的假新闻故事。媒体总是试图在我们之间挑起戏剧性的事件，但迈克非常棒！

source: Based on some early results, it appears that many polls significantly overestimated Biden's support. This may be close after all.
zh: 根据一些早期结果，许多民意调查似乎明显高估了拜登的支持率。毕竟这可能很接近。

source: Until you threw in the China comment, this sounded like a relatively restrained opening statement for you.
zh: 在您提出有关中国的评论之前，这对您来说听起来像是一个相对克制的开场白。

source: Your core supporters believe every word of this, but does it have enough appeal to swing voters?
zh: 你的核心支持者相信这一切，但它对摇摆选民有足够的吸引力吗？

source: Lord knows you've gone on aggrieved attack mode plenty of times over the past four years. But is it enough to get you over the hump for a second term?
zh: 天知道，在过去的四年里，你已经多次陷入委屈的攻击模式。但这足以帮助你渡过第二个任期的难关吗？

source: This seems like a confident, assertive, but well-grounded theme to base your campaign on.
zh: 这似乎是一个自信、果断、但有理有据的主题，可以作为您的竞选活动的基础。

source: It's good to mix things up and hit Democrats where they're vulnerable, especially in areas where your criticism might catch on with independent voters.
zh: 将事情混合起来并打击民主党的弱势是件好事，特别是在你的批评可能会受到独立选民欢迎的领域。

source: You are the incumbent President with four years of accomplishments to run on. You're playing into everyone's worst caricature of you when you focus on petty insults like this.
zh: 您是现任总统，将继续取得四年的成就。当你专注于这样的小侮辱时，你就是在扮演每个人对你最糟糕的讽刺。

source: You have your own way of stating it, but Biden would be the oldest President in history. Is it really a bad idea to point that out, loudly and repeatedly?
zh: 你有你自己的说法，但拜登将是历史上最年长的总统。大声、反复地指出这一点真的是一个坏主意吗？

source: Your statements on COVID and China are quite inflammatory here. Of course, that may not matter to your supporters this November.
zh: 你关于新冠病毒和中国的言论在这里非常具有煽动性。当然，今年十一月这对你的支持者来说可能并不重要。

source: The trick with COVID is to strike a sensible compromise between slowing the spread of the disease, and protecting the health of the economy.
zh: 应对新冠肺炎的诀窍是在减缓疾病传播和保护经济健康之间达成明智的妥协。

source: There are certainly rumblings of discontent with the scientific establishment, but your best path to reelection probably consists in handling COVID well.
zh: 确实存在对科学机构不满的传言，但连任的最佳途径可能在于妥善处理新冠疫情。

source: Joe Biden is definitely more popular with independents than the progressive left is. One way to hit at Biden is to suggest that he's not the one really calling the shots in the modern Democratic Party.
zh: 乔·拜登绝对比进步左派更受独立人士欢迎。攻击拜登的一种方法是表明他并不是现代民主党中真正发号施令的人。

source: Trying to drive a wedge between the two wings of the Democratic Party might not be a bad idea. Then again, they hate you far more than they hate each other.
zh: 尝试在民主党的两个机翼之间插入楔子可能不是一个坏主意。话又说回来，他们恨你远胜过恨对方。

source: In part due to statements like this, America is rapidly becoming polarized on the question of COVID precautions. Will that help you in November?
zh: 部分由于此类言论，美国在新冠预防措施问题上迅速变得两极分化。这对你十一月有帮助吗？

source: Health authorities express concern about your refusal to wear a mask at some large events, but will your supporters care?
zh: 卫生当局对您在一些大型活动中拒绝戴口罩表示担忧，但您的支持者会关心吗？

source: You seem to be gambling that your voters will reluctantly follow your lead on this issue. And who knows, if COVID goes away sooner, it can only help you.
zh: 您似乎在赌博，您的选民将不情愿地在这个问题上追随您的领导。谁知道呢，如果新冠病毒早点消失，只会对您有所帮助。

source: Commentators have noticed a remarkably restrained public persona over the last few weeks.
zh: 评论员注意到过去几周公众形象非常克制。

source: It has been a raucous and emotional couple of weeks in America, and you are certainly doing your part to keep it that way.
zh: 在美国度过了喧闹而情绪化的几周，你当然正在尽自己的努力来保持这种状态。

source: Democrats like to portray themselves as stronger on racial justice issues. Maybe your best strategy is, indeed, to turn the tables on them. When is the last time Republicans ran anything in Minneapolis?
zh: 民主党人喜欢将自己描绘成在种族正义问题上更强的人。也许你最好的策略确实是扭转局面。共和党最后一次在明尼阿波利斯进行竞选是什么时候？

source: It's hard to make Hunter Biden stay in the mainstream news, but your supporters are certainly keeping up with his story.
zh: 很难让亨特拜登留在主流新闻中，但你的支持者肯定会关注他的故事。

source: It might not be traditional Republican policy, but no one can deny that these are unusual and exceptional times.
zh: 这可能不是传统的共和党政策，但没有人可以否认这是一个不寻常和特殊的时代。

source: You might not win this battle, but maybe you can shame Nancy Pelosi as much as possible while it's taking place.
zh: 你可能不会赢得这场战斗，但也许你可以在战斗发生时尽可能地羞辱南希·佩洛西。
